Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Sapphire Avenue Exchange travel now sends one aethernet request attempt, waits for it to settle, then proceeds to the Market Board shortcut even if Lifestream does not return a positive confirmation. This prevents repeated Sapphire requests after arrival.
